title: Made an open-source app to auto-pauses YT during an in-game dialogue
author: Neither-Deer4039
selftext:
I like to watch YouTube while playing story games, but it's annoying when a cut-scene starts and I miss the dialogue because someone's already talking in my ear.

So I built a little Windows app that listens to just the game's audio and pauses YT or Spotify when it hears voices. A couple seconds after the talking stops, it resumes.

It doesn't touch the game itself, so it's should be fine with anti-cheat. Works with Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. Windows only and free.

It's fully open source, and I'd really love feedback: bugs, games where it misbehaves, feature ideas, or code critiques are all welcome. PRs too, if you feel like it.

Download at: [https://projects.swikrut.com/#/yt-game-pauser](https://projects.swikrut.com/#/yt-game-pauser)  
Check out the repo: [https://github.com/SwikrutD/yt-game-pauser](https://github.com/SwikrutD/yt-game-pauser)
